name: AR_CONS_BILL_CYCLES_B
description: The AR_CONS_BILL_CYCLES_B table stores information on defined cycles. Receivables creates one row for each billing cycle that you define. This information is used to distinguish which activity to include on a bill.

columns.name: BILLING_CYCLE_ID
columns.description: Billing cycle identifier

columns.name: BILL_CYCLE_TYPE

columns.name: START_DATE

columns.name: CYCLE_FREQUENCY
